usedFor: JustCall handles your calls, and TURKEY SMS texts the caller through your TURKEY SMS account when “Missed Call” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Missed Call” in JustCall, then “Send SMS” in TURKEY SMS
bestTemplate.why: A caller who got no answer gets a text straight away, so the lead is not lost.

watchOut: “Send SMS” goes to a specified number, so map the caller's number from “Missed Call” into it.
